description: An empty playlist owned by a scene, for one of its playlist sources to play (a stream's own two playlists come with the stream). Fill it with apply_playlist_operations. Each call creates another. Returns the new playlist: id (pl_...), name, sceneId, kind, mode, version, createdAt.

kind.description: The media it holds: video items for a picture source, audio items for a sound source.

name.description: A name to tell it apart in list_playlists, e.g. 'Lower-third clips'.

sceneId.description: The scene that owns it (scn_...), from list_scenes.

name: create_playlist

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Create a scene playlist
